notes.title: Major Balance and Feature Update!
notes.content:
See the Facebook page or News dialog for full details.

- New Worker - Researcher - Research your way through a Skill tree for some new powers and features
- New Building - Market - Check out your Market on the weekend to see some Stone deals that you can't pass up
- New Building - Worker Altar - Research this in the skills menu for a daily Worker Levelup
- New Leaderboard - Climb your way through the Season 3 Leaderboard

The idea behind this update is to focus more on Workers being useful, as well as add some more stuff to do for players already deep in the game. Population has changed greatly, and there's more of a focus on the idle aspects of the game. Check out the Community Hub for more details or to ask questions!

notes.title: Halloween Event 2020
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30645422/d5bfd507b0cffb1f5766b1d5db39d7deec992cd2.png

Added a couple of small things for the event this year. Candy works slightly different and is no longer time based, as well as added a new Monster and leaderboard.

I'm also working on some new content that will hopefully be out after a few months, so stay tuned! I'll include more info a bit later.

notes.title: New Leaderboard, New Update!
notes.content:
There's a new update that should be out for all platforms.
-New leaderboard season - Start climbing the new leaderboard!
-New buyable item: Battleship. Battleship can increase the max number of ships you can build 
-Casinos now give 'scratch cards', which are random bonuses depending on how lucky you are
-Other small fixes and improvements

Also added a new gem code that will expire next month so grab some gems!
